highlight_subsections.heading: MiniMax-M3
highlight_subsections.summary: **MiniMax-M3**: Added support for the new **MiniMax-M3** model (#45381), with a fast follow-on of BF16/FP8 indexer via MSA (#45892), MXFP4 support (#45896), FP8 sparse GQA (#45744), and extensive AMD/ROCm tuning — mxfp8 MoE/linear on gfx950 (#45725), fp8_per_channel for bf16 weights on MI300X (#45854), FP8 KV-cache fix (#45720), and packed-modules mapping (#45794). A MiniMax-M2 perf regression was also fixed (#45935).

highlight_subsections.heading: DeepSeek-V4 keeps maturing
highlight_subsections.summary: **DeepSeek-V4 keeps maturing**: Following its debut, DeepSeek-V4 received another large optimization pass — a FlashInfer sparse index cache (2–4% TTFT) (#45863), prefill chunk-planning optimization (4% E2E throughput) (#45061), a cluster-cooperative topK kernel for low-latency (#43008), contiguous per-block KV allocations (#44577), TEP=16 for the block-FP8 shared expert (#46001), and native DSA indexer decode for `next_n > 2` on SM100 (#45322). It is now enabled on **SM120** alongside GLM-5.1 (#43477), with XPU (#44144, #44517, #45240) and ROCm (#44899, #45103, #45681) attention/MoE paths added.

highlight_subsections.heading: Model Runner V2 (MRv2) continues to expand
highlight_subsections.summary: **Model Runner V2 (MRv2) continues to expand**: MRv2 now **supports quantized models by default** (#44446), enables **GraniteMoE by default** (#45461), and gained migration of Qwen + DeepSeek-V2 MoE models (#42667), DFlash speculative decoding (#44586), and more accurate FP32 Gumbel sampling (#45996).

highlight_subsections.heading: Streaming Parser Engine
highlight_subsections.summary: **Streaming Parser Engine**: A new streaming parser engine unifies tool-call/reasoning parsing across models, with parsers for Qwen3 (#45413), MiniMax-M2 (#45701), GLM-4.7/5.1/5.2 (#45915), and Nemotron V3 (#45755).

highlight_subsections.heading: Diffusion LLMs
highlight_subsections.summary: **Diffusion LLMs**: Added **DiffusionGemma** (#45163), including a CPU path (#45690) and structured-output guardrails for diffusion decoders (#45468).

highlight_subsections.heading: WideEP / DeepEP v2
highlight_subsections.summary: **WideEP / DeepEP v2**: Integrated **DeepEP v2** for expert parallelism (#41183), with follow-on robustness fixes (#46404, #46432).

highlight_subsections.heading: Rust frontend matures further
highlight_subsections.summary: **Rust frontend matures further**: Added API-key authentication (#44321), CORS (#45753), `/tokenize` + `/detokenize` (#44222), `/pause` `/resume` `/is_paused` (#44499), `/abort_requests` (#44382), `/get_world_size` (#44801), `thinking_token_budget` (#46137), a Python bridge for Rust tool parsers (#44624), and many new parsers and validation paths.

highlight_subsections.heading: Device selection change
highlight_subsections.summary: **Device selection change**: vLLM no longer sets `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` internally; a new `device_ids` argument is provided instead (#45026). On ROCm, a deprecation window for `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` has begun (#46636).

upgrade_rows.change: **Removed models**: ERNIE (obsolete) (#45127), Xverse (#45638), Dots1 (#45637), Bamba (#45990), Mono-InternVL (#45129), InternLM registry alias (#45128).
**Deprecated**: First-generation Qwen and QwenVL models (#45131), Transformers v4 support (#45161), `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` on ROCm (#46636); general deprecations for v0.23/v0.24 (#44992).

ground_truth_benchmarks.claim: **CPU & other architectures**: 2.5× faster ASR CPU preprocessing via multi-threading (#44612), CPU W4A16 INT4 MoE (#43409), cgroup memory-limit-aware KV cache sizing (#45086), RISC-V oneDNN W8A8 INT8 (#44478) and RVV micro-GEMM for WNA16 (#44324), pinned memory for WSL2 (#41496), ZenCPU runtime logging (#42726).
